canonical_title: Probability of concussion - backup through-canopy ejection

versions.title_at_revision: Probability of concussion - backup through-canopy ejection
versions.text:
Standard: Standard: The maximum P concussion during a through-canopy backup mode ejection is 15% when calculated using the probability of concussion equation (Rowson and Duma). 𝑃𝑃𝑐𝑐𝑐𝑐𝑐𝑐𝑐𝑐𝑐𝑐𝑐𝑐𝑐𝑐𝑐𝑐𝑐𝑐𝑐𝑐 = 1 1 + 𝑒𝑒−(−10.2+.0433𝖺𝖺+0.000873𝛼𝛼−0.00000092𝖺𝖺𝑎𝑎) Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Analysis.
(1) Acceleration and rate data is used to calculate P concussion. Calculations will use the maximum angular resultant acceleration within a ±30ms time window centered around each resultant linear acceleration at each recorded time step. Test.
  (1) Lab test: Data is collected from full system-level dynamic ejection sled testing using instrumented manikins.
